hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Production casing
function: The string run to total depth through the lateral, cemented across the pay, and used as the frac conduit: treatments are pumped through it and the frac plugs seal in it.

tabs.overview: Burst rating checked for the frac treating pressure plus margin; drift diameter sets the plug and tool sizes; premium or semi-premium connections for the pressure cycles; cement quality across the lateral sets stage isolation.
tabs.engineering: Per API 5CT; 5-1/2 in. 20 lb/ft P110 class is common on shale wells.
tabs.safety: Casing test before the frac; wear and connection leaks are the failure modes that stop a job.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
